resolution_note: County-level screening layer. Scored from county-level facts only: EPA Green Book designation, the state agency overlay, and the hand-entered county posture file. It cannot see parcel-level PSD increment consumption, terrain relief, Class I area distance or gas pipeline reachability. The parcel run is the real answer.

reference_config.description: 500 MW combined_cycle_turbine on natural_gas (dry_low_nox, scr, oxidation_catalyst), no enforceable hour cap (PTE at 8760)
reference_config.emission_factor_basis: AP-42 Table 3.1-1 (same combustor factors; the CC advantage shows up in heat rate, and duct firing is modelled separately)

hard_stops: Sarasota County moratorium: Commissioners voted on 9 July 2026 to halt acceptance, review and approval of hyperscale data center applications until at least July 2027. Hyperscale follows the state definition of 50 MW or more, so sub-50 MW facilities are outside the freeze.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.

DeKalb County moratorium: A moratorium on data center applications has been in place since July 2025. On 9 June 2026 the Commission voted 5-2 to extend it another 100 days, through 30 September 2026.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.
Walker County moratorium: The Board of Commissioners approved a temporary moratorium on data centers, announced by the county on 10 July 2026.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.

Marshall County moratorium: Commissioners enacted a permanent ban on data centers effective immediately on 20 April 2026, replacing the one-year moratorium already in place. Reported as the first outright county ban in Indiana.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.

Linn County moratorium: On 1 July 2026 the Board of Supervisors imposed an 18-month moratorium on new applications to rezone into the EU-3 Large-Scale Data Center district, effective immediately through 11:59pm on 1 January 2028. Unincorporated Linn County only - it does not bind Cedar Rapids or the other incorporated cities.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.

Montgomery County moratorium: Expedited Bill 19-26, adopted 28 July 2026, bars the Department of Permitting Services from issuing any data center permit for 18 months. It reaches applications filed before the effective date, applications pending review, and approvals that have not yet had a building permit issued.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.

Prince George's County moratorium: County Council approved a two-year moratorium on hyperscale data center development on 7 July 2026, the longest pause in Maryland. It can be lifted early if the county adopts a zoning framework setting where data centers may go and on what conditions.. The air permit timeline is irrelevant until this lifts.
